clauses.heading: Parties
clauses.body: This Agreement is made between Brightpath Supplies Inc and Cedar Health Ltd.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.body: The term is set out in clause 2.1 to clause 2.3 below.

clauses.heading: Commencement
clauses.body: The term commences three (3) months after 1 June 2025, the date this Agreement is signed.

clauses.heading: Duration
clauses.body: The term is two (2) years from the commencement date.

clauses.heading: Renewal
clauses.body: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives notice under clause 7. Notice to prevent renewal must be given three (3) months before the end of the term.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.body: Charges are payable monthly on the fifteenth day of each month.

clauses.heading: Price Changes
clauses.body: Prices are fixed for the term and do not increase.

clauses.heading: Limitation of Liability
clauses.body: The liability of either party is capped at two times the annual fees.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.body: Either party may terminate for material breach on thirty (30) days written notice.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.body: Each party keeps the other party's information confidential.

clauses.heading: Notice of Non-Renewal
clauses.body: Notices under this Agreement are given in writing to the other party.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
